story.title: Celebrate With Us
story.text: Dear friends and family,It brings us great joy to share this special day with you. We warmly invite you to our wedding, which will take place in the town of Vinci — a place filled with love and emotion. Vinci is a small but remarkable town in Tuscany, known as the birthplace of Leonardo da Vinci.  Your presence is the greatest gift we could ask for. Let’s create unforgettable memories together ❤️

event5.place: Aperitivo & Antipasto are an important part of Italian culture — we will welcome our guests with a selection of carefully chosen appetizers, along with traditional Tuscan white and red wines, and cocktails.

explore.title: Explore Tuscany
explore.intro: While you're here, we warmly recommend exploring some of the most beautiful towns in Tuscany — each within easy reach of Vinci.

city1.name: San Miniato
city1.desc: A charming hilltop town renowned for its white truffles and breathtaking views over the Arno valley.
city1.distance: ~25 km from Vinci · ~25 min by car

city2.name: San Gimignano
city2.desc: The 'Medieval Manhattan' of Tuscany — a UNESCO World Heritage site famous for its iconic medieval towers.
city2.distance: ~45 km from Vinci · ~45 min by car

city3.name: Volterra
city3.desc: An ancient Etruscan city perched on a dramatic ridge, known for its alabaster crafts and sweeping Tuscan landscapes.
city3.distance: ~60 km from Vinci · ~1 hour by car
